expectation: Build one shared harness that runs the frozen, byte-identical job-recovery fixture (blueprints/convergence-practice/job-recovery/fixture.py with the unchanged planner and 12-test oracle) on Dagu 2.16.6, Prefect 3.8.6 (fresh uv venv, new prefix, local `prefect server start` on loopback) and a Temporal dev server (temporal CLI 1.9.1 release archive checksum-verified, temporalio 1.33.0 in a fresh venv). Cases: stop (engine-native stop/cancel while finalize waits), retry (engine-native retry of the same run), checkpoint reuse (claim count 1, checkpoint sha unchanged, 12 tests before/after) and SIGKILL (SIGKILL the executor process group mid-finalize, then an engine-native recovery attempt bounded at 150 s). Record the same oracle fields as run_parity.py. Expected: Dagu passes stop/retry/reuse and its SIGKILL recovery is refused without a scheduler (as #87 saw); Temporal passes all four (reset for retry; activity heartbeat timeout for SIGKILL); Prefect passes stop/retry/reuse via flow.serve + `prefect flow-run cancel/retry`, and its SIGKILL case leaves the run Running (uncertain).
criteria: Settled iff the harness exists in the repository and executed all four cases on both Prefect and Temporal (pass or fail are both results), each installed at a pinned version in a new prefix, with the run_parity.py oracle fields recorded per engine. Restate is outside the next_check and is named as not covered. If either challenger cannot run a case, outcome is advanced with the missing case named.
